description: All-Claude family picks — claude-haiku-4-5 keeps flash exploration low-cost, claude-sonnet-5 runs standard orchestration plus pro+max coding and review: at $2/$10 it is newer and cheaper than the retired pro/max pick claude-sonnet-4-6 ($3/$15) and is the strongest family member inside the cost red line on OpenCode Zen (opus-5-5 at $4/$20 and fable-5-1 at $10/$50 are excluded). Vision uses sonnet-5 for attachments. Requires OPENCODE_API_KEY environment variable (OpenCode Zen).
